one_line: Founder of the Chaulukya (Solanki) rule in Gujarat during the post-Pratihara, post-Rashtrakuta upheavals.

appearance.age_look: Early 40s, medium height, compact and athletic build with the presence of a seasoned warrior-king.
appearance.face: Oval face with a strong jaw, medium-deep brown complexion, sharp straight nose, neatly trimmed moustache, short close beard along the jawline, a small tilaka on the forehead, and a default expression that is calm, alert and quietly resolute.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair pulled back into a small, high knot at the back of the crown, the front hairline smooth; he wears a simple but finely worked gold circlet-band across the forehead with a tiny central lotus motif and no tall crown.
appearance.costume: He wears a long-sleeved cotton angarkha (wrap tunic) in muted deep maroon with a wrap opening to the right, reaching just below the knees and edged with a narrow gold border, belted at the waist with a broad dark brown leather girdle that has small bronze fittings; over this is a sleeveless quilted cotton armour-vest in dull indigo with subtle vertical stitching lines, fitted but not bulky; his lower garment is a tightly wrapped white cotton dhoti with a faint pale-cream border, pleated in front and tucked securely for riding and combat; a light ochre-yellow cotton uttariya (shawl) with a thin red stripe border is draped from the left shoulder across the torso and around the back, leaving the arms free; he wears simple brown leather boots reaching mid-calf, suitable for both horse and ground warfare, and modest gold stud earrings plus one plain armlet on the right arm to hint at royal status without ostentation.
appearance.signature: A slightly curved single-edged steel sword of early talwar form with a plain cross-guard and a dark brown wrapped hilt, worn at his left side in a simple leather scabbard suspended from his girdle, always held or slung in a ready-but-composed manner.

ref_desc: Mularaja I is a medium-built, brown-skinned warrior-king in his early 40s with an oval face, trimmed moustache-beard, black hair in a small back knot under a simple gold circlet, wearing a deep maroon angarkha, indigo quilted vest, white dhoti, ochre shawl, brown boots, and carrying a curved steel sword at his left side.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Mularaja I, founder of the Chaulukya dynasty: a medium-height, compactly built man in his early 40s with an oval brown face, strong jaw, straight nose, neatly trimmed moustache and close beard along the jawline, calm and alert expression, and thick black hair pulled back into a small knot high at the back of the crown. He wears a simple golden circlet-band across his forehead with a tiny central lotus motif, not a tall crown. His main garment is a long-sleeved deep maroon cotton angarkha (wrap tunic) that wraps to the right and falls just below the knees, edged with a narrow gold border, cinched at the waist with a broad dark brown leather girdle decorated with small bronze fittings. Over this, show a sleeveless quilted cotton armour-vest in dull indigo with visible vertical stitching, snug over the torso. His lower garment is a tightly wrapped white cotton dhoti with faint pale-cream edging, pleated and tucked forward to suggest practical mobility. A light ochre-yellow cotton uttariya (shawl) with thin red stripe borders is draped from his left shoulder diagonally across his chest and around his back, falling in soft folds without covering his hands. He wears simple brown leather mid-calf boots suited for riding and marching, small gold stud earrings, and a single plain armlet on his right upper arm. At his left side, attached to the girdle, is his signature weapon: a slightly curved single-edged steel sword of early talwar form with a plain cross-guard, dark brown wrapped hilt, and a modest leather scabbard; in some poses his hand rests lightly on the hilt to show readiness. Use a palette dominated by deep maroon, indigo, white, ochre yellow, and dark brown, with small gold accents, and present front, side, and back views to clearly show his face, hair knot, circlet, layered garments, boots, and sword placement.
